name: Certified Mail
tagline: Sends certified letters with return receipts through the Lob API
description: Prepares and sends certified letters with return receipts through the Lob API. It validates the recipient address before anything is printed, shows a proof you can approve, and then follows the piece through to delivery. Bring your own Lob key and the per-letter cost is just postage.
author: zrottmann
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
